# group member

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:groupMember`](gmeow-groupMember.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/groupMember>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A member condition of this group. At least two (SHACL); nest groups for arbitrary trees.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionGroup.md) -> [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:groupMember`](gmeow-groupMember.md) from [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionGroup.md) to [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionGroup.md), [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a member condition to a condition group; nest groups as members for arbitrary boolean trees.

### Avoid when

- Avoid a group with fewer than two members (SHACL requires at least two) and avoid using it outside a [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionGroup.md).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:groupMember`](gmeow-groupMember.md) from the group to each member [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) (including nested groups), paired with a [`gmeow:groupOperator`](gmeow-groupOperator.md).

### Examples

- ex:cg1 [`gmeow:groupMember`](gmeow-groupMember.md) ex:c1, ex:c2.
